scope: Bounded independent mechanical, arithmetic, OEM-family and drawing consistency review. Not professional engineering approval, brake qualification or fabrication release.
confirmed_findings: Demand torque is separated from maximum actuator, fault and structural loads.
Rotational allowance affects brake torque and energy, not total external rail contact force at prescribed translational deceleration.
Allocation-empty comparisons retain the same equivalent physical wheelset inertia.
Dexter catalog pp12/19/20 supports coherent 12.25x4 PQ / 20-24 combination family and cited OEM part identifiers. This does not qualify the adapted rail assembly.
Two drums per axle give 363.825 Nm each in ideal shared upper-load 600mm/.7m/s2/5-percent case; this is demand, not brake output.
500/600mm rail wheels are packaging probes; 311.15mm is drum friction ID, not outside diameter; no invented drum clearance or flange bolt circle.
Stationary spider/carrier follows nonrotating axlebox; hub and drum rotate with axle. No spider weld to rotating axle.
Hub flange remains on OEM supported side of drum face; service extraction removes custom hub and drum together.
Reverse cam-direction warning is retained as release gate. Dexter service manual p52 confirms opposite cam/wheel direction may cause chatter/hop; repeated bidirectional capability is not established.
Low mean cycle heat is not represented as thermal qualification; cold/hot/drag and repeated-stop gates retained.
PAN17 legacy/current chamber variants and 325/330mm drawing discrepancy are visible; dimensions are not silently merged.
No chamber type is converted into a constant output-force curve; no unsupported pressure, spring rating or stroke match.
Final M03 torque-plane inset supports a mechanically possible reaction relationship; it is not a completed 3D suspension/articulation design.

corrections.finding: M03 plan-view link alone has no moment arm about in-plane axle axis. Must define or explicitly hold the missing 3D reaction geometry.
corrections.requested: Add side-elevation with nonzero lever arm/out-of-plane force or label projected 3D geometry clearly; do not imply plan offset alone resists axle torque.
corrections.resolution: Final M03 now labels upper diagram as plan projection insufficient by itself, and adds an end view with nonzero perpendicular arm h and F=T/h. Exact 3D link geometry remains an engineering hold.

corrections.finding: M01 carrier/OEM drum labels overlap; M03 long left-column labels touch next column.
corrections.resolution: Rerendered M01 label separation and M03 table labels visually inspected; requested overlaps corrected.

corrections.finding: Layout parameter source URL is PENDING.
corrections.requested: Use exact Dexter catalog URL already in drum sources.
corrections.resolution: Parameter register now uses the exact linked Dexter medium-duty catalog URL.

corrections.finding: Larger PAN17 wording may imply physically smaller/lighter drum without full envelope/mass evidence.
corrections.requested: Compare road family ratings only; explicitly preserve installed-size/mass/cost uncertainty.
corrections.resolution: Decision now distinguishes road application range from installed size, mass and cost; none is asserted superior without evidence.

corrections.finding: Eight combination chambers per coach implies32 coach chambers; previous trainline air demand may not reflect this architecture.
corrections.requested: Make reservoir/recharge/apply/release timing recalculation explicit before system release.
corrections.resolution: Decision explicitly requires revised usable reservoir capacity, compressor duty, line/valve flow, application/release timing and spring-release capacity for32 coach chambers plus separately selected locomotive chambers.

corrections.finding: Two-per-axle decision should identify serviceability/load-path reason rather than imply working torque requires two units.
corrections.requested: State component-count/mass/air-demand tradeoff and no unproved redundancy credit.
corrections.resolution: Decision identifies paired wheel-end modules and separate reaction paths as architecture rationale, explicitly disclaims torque necessity and redundancy credit; drum report states mass/expense consequences.

source_crosscheck.Dexter_OEM_catalog: Local downloaded primary catalog text pp12/19/20 inspected against part register.
source_crosscheck.source_date_note: 2019.09/2018.11 catalogs are historical revisions still linked by current product pages; access date must not be mistaken for new publication date.

Parking spring output and fault behavior
Actual drum/chamber/cam/adjuster envelope and wear/extraction motion
Hub/axle/carrier strength, fatigue, retention and tolerances
Full air demand and trainline transient response
Qualified engineering review and prototype testing
publication_condition: Suitable to publish only as conditional component-family selection and preliminary custom-interface development with the release holds retained. Not shop-ready and not rail validated.
final_visual_note: Final M01 drum/hub mating-face depiction reviewed after removal of schematic gap; OEM outboard support side retained.
